instruction: Install Spotify on this Windows PC and leave it ready to use.
gt_steps: Open a web browser or package installer.
Find the official Spotify app for Windows.
Download and run the Spotify installer, or install Spotify from a trusted Windows package source.
Verify that Spotify is installed by checking that the Spotify app or executable exists.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$paths=@(\"$env:APPDATA\Spotify\Spotify.exe\",\"$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\WindowsApps\Spotify.exe\"); foreach ($p in $paths) { if (Test-Path $p) { Write-Output 'SPOTIFY_FOUND'; exit 0 } }; $appx=Get-AppxPackage -Name SpotifyAB.SpotifyMusic -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($appx) { Write-Output 'SPOTIFY_FOUND'; exit 0 }; $uninstall=@('HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*','HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*','HKLM:\Software\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*'); foreach ($key in $uninstall) { $hit=Get-ItemProperty $key -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -match 'Spotify' } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($hit) { Write-Output 'SPOTIFY_FOUND'; exit 0 } }; Write-Output 'SPOTIFY_NOT_FOUND'; exit 1"
